scope: Time physical CPU pipeline fetches at logical PC+8 (ARM) / PC+4 (Thumb), retaining logical instruction/stream identities
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud host; Temurin 21.0.8; Maven 3.9.11; independent headless reference captures

change.bug: Normal fetch waits used the executing instruction address. At physical 128 KiB Game Pak boundaries this charged nonsequential waits at the wrong retirement. Discarded IRQ fetches already used the two-slot lookahead.
change.fix: Share the physical lookahead rule for normal and discarded fetches; opcode reads and stream sequencing keep logical addresses. No wait constants, seed writes, LCD phase or activation policy changed.
change.regression_guard: Move the existing end-of-Game-Pak primer so its physical read is still inside ROM; the following fetch reaches SRAM with an active prefetch buffer.

independent_gate.scope: Only the fetch stream after return retirement; full IRQ entry/return/refill latency and opcode latching remain separate gates.

game_gate.controls_provenance: Archived baseline/reference outputs retain their recorded source identities. Fresh controls for Sonic Advance 3 and LeafGreen match the archived baseline complete RGB/PCM hashes and sample counts. All candidate outputs are new. This is a correctness regression gate, not a physical or sustained performance result.
game_gate.candidate_provenance: Initial Sonic/LeafGreen candidates used an isolated BusTiming override with the same physical-fetch expression and the pre-existing equivalent discarded-fetch expression. The other 13 candidates use the compiled reviewed source. The reviewed change delegates discardedFetch to fetch; its host and actual CLDC micro-observations match the isolated candidate and both references byte-for-byte.

strict_stream_comparison.note: Exact hashes expose differences; mGBA filtering and guest timing can both affect audio. No perceptual tolerance is applied.

player_save_gate.scope: Position x=6,y=8,map=3/0 and money 3000 remain correct. Every route RGB frame is unchanged, and all 3611 prior reference-exact frames remain exact. New host/reference files differ in 702 bytes, including 35 unclassified activity bytes; strict save and full RGB/PCM gates still fail. Successful cold loading does not remove those differences.

trace_report.scope: RAM changes observed between public CPU steps, not exact bus timestamps or retirement events; unchanged stores are absent. No observation callbacks or guest writes. Input save is read only; full RGB/PCM hashes are retained.

old_state_compatibility.scope: Read existing format-1 files without changing their bytes; corrected host and actual new ECJ/CLDC core retain exact full state/RGB/PCM over 120 future frames. This is cross-runtime consistency, not equality to pre-correction future execution.

remaining_irq_gate.unshipped_refill_experiment: Routing refill reads through the prefetch helper removes additional NBA differences but is not adopted: independent models disagree on refill/prefetch-stop timing. Preserve raw full traces and obtain justified expectations before changing that policy.

validation.sdk_rapc: JDE 7.1 / ECJ 4.6.1 / RAPC: No errors; development COD/JAD built

reproduction.micro: Follow docs/SCENARIOS.md#cartridge-fetch-stream-after-irq-return. Default NBA, mGBA, corrected host and isolated actual CLDC CSVs must match the fixture. Preserve --full-trace discrepancies.
reproduction.tests: mvn verify; tools/test-with-console.sh; tools/blackberry.sh with the pinned JDE/ECJ; tools/test-cldc-core.sh
reproduction.games: Replay each recorded properties/input/frame budget using owned save/output paths. Compare every RGB hash to the same baseline/reference traces; no previous exact frame may be lost. Preserve full RGB/PCM mismatch outcomes.
reproduction.player: Replay the existing LeafGreen overworld-save.tsv route for 4190 frames with the same hash-verified generation-3 seed. Cross-load the new save in fresh host/reference runs with overworld-continue.tsv for 1700 frames. Refresh the read-only RAM trace at 0x03005000 and assert video/PCM/save hashes remain identical to the untraced route.
